purpose: Proposed accuracy thresholds, recorded before the full measured batch is graded. The operator alone approves them; this file changes no merge policy.
model_control: Same configured Codex model and reasoning effort for all three independent passes; record actual configuration and emitted model IDs.
conditions: Report instance and independent-class recall; both must satisfy the proposed minimum.
Combined reviewers must meet or exceed the legacy baseline's recall and precision on identical replay inputs.
Precision includes independently adjudicated unexpected findings and flags all judgement findings separately.
A missing or invalid run remains a recall miss; no survivor-only accuracy score.
Bad commits are unique actual fixes rejected by the other axis or failing targeted tests; all actual fixes form the denominator.
Untested fixes make the observed bad-commit rate a lower bound, never policy-ready evidence.
Before enabling policy, rerun through the real registered installed 3.39.0 shadow protocol and retain actual dispatch/round/verification/cross-check receipts.
The supervisor supplies runtime assembly proof and targeted-test receipts; the worker never runs Rust builds/tests.
Thresholds require explicit operator approval and cannot be relaxed merely because this batch fails.
limitations: Fourteen instances represent twelve independent defect classes, not a large random sample of future work.
The four negatives are corrected real slices; extra findings require independent adjudication, not automatic false labeling.
Current stored task descriptions/criteria may omit historical operator clarifications; report source-coverage gaps separately from reviewer misses.
The Standards snapshot does not explicitly prescribe every security or organization-hygiene seed; report that source-coverage limit without inventing rules.
Historical fixture failures are real test defects, not claims that the same behaviors failed in production.
The initial isolated replay measures model behavior but simulates API authority and protocol.

bridge_transport_approval.production_difference: Production shadow uses side refs directly; simulated runner commits only reviewer-selected in-scope files.

corpus_revision.reason: Two genuine latent defects found in nominal negatives are preserved; c20 authentic corrected factory-only slice restores four eligible clean negatives. Same-fix correlation and post-discovery selection bias are disclosed.
